evidence: Changes address management in AddrMan (`src/addrman.cpp`, `src/addrman.h`) and carries the P2P label.
rationale: Prevents AddrMan from incorrectly penalizing and suppressing valid addresses when only a specific network encounters local connectivity failure. As described in the PR, a global `m_last_good` timestamp causes failed connection attempts on an unreachable network (e.g., IPv6 or Tor) to mark addresses 'Terrible' even though connectivity is functioning on other networks.
